common.implementation: Direct React JSX and forwardRef; static action sources do not justify invented hook state or effects. Native node, standard events, stable render identity. No DOM controller, iframe or innerHTML.
common.shared_primitive: Small private JSX NativeButton handles only ordinary native button wrapper/guard; nine exported components explicitly implement source-specific icons, sizes, fixed-disabled, dots, gradient, destructive face and pill. No inherited test credit from scalar Button01.
common.events: Standard onClick once while active. Native onClick preventDefault retains default-action cancellation. Return values/promises ignored; exceptions surface through React. No post-callback work. All other native events passed through.
common.readOnly: Adapter addition because HTML button lacks readOnly. Maps to aria-disabled=true and cancels click/default action, remains focusable unless independently disabled. Never forwards readonly attribute.
common.fixed_disabled: Button05 and Button09 are permanently disabled exact-source samples. Runtime overwrites disabled=false; types only accept disabled=true. Button09 also fixes aria-busy=true.
common.form: Default type=button is a safety change from the source primitive omitted type. Explicit submit/reset native semantics are forwarded. No form field model or reset listeners are needed.
common.focus_cleanup: React owns native ref lifecycle including StrictMode. No automatic focus or asynchronous work to clean up. Host takes focus and may synchronously replace/unmount.
common.theme_motion: Original seven token palettes unchanged; scoped CSS uses semantic tokens. Source sky gradient is mapped to theme accent. Reduced-motion and forced-colours rules authored but require real-browser verification.
common.source_license: Watermelon MIT notice preserved in src/next-buttons/LICENSE.upstream. Raw local pinned variant and primitive source copies included. All icon SVG geometry locally authored.
